licence.title: Licences
licence.description: A seat lets teachers sign in on the panel in a room. The seat belongs to the room, so it stays when a panel is replaced.

note.shadow: Not enforced yet. Teachers can still sign in on every panel, whatever its seat status.
note.unmanaged: Seats are not managed for this institute. Teachers can sign in on every panel.
note.overLimit: More rooms hold a seat than you have seats. Release the seat of a room you no longer use.
note.ended: Your licence has ended. Teachers cannot sign in on panels that need a seat.

grants.title: Licence periods
grants.grace: Grace period after the end, in days: {{days}}

empty.title: No rooms with a panel yet
empty.body: Rooms show here once a panel is paired to them.

assign.title: Assign a seat to {{room}}?
assign.body: Teachers can sign in on the panel in {{room}}. This uses one of your free seats.

release.title: Release the seat of {{room}}?
release.body: While seats are enforced, teachers cannot sign in on the panel in {{room}}. A class already running is not stopped. The seat becomes free for another room.

errors.NO_SEAT: Every seat is in use. Release the seat of another room first.

installers.title: Installers
installers.description: An installer can set up panels in your rooms. Each panel they set up waits for your approval under Panels & rooms.

empty.title: No installers yet
empty.body: Create a code and give it to the installer who sets up your panels.

invite.open: Let an installer set up panels
invite.title: Let an installer set up panels
invite.intro: You get a code to give the installer. They enter it in the Classroom app on their phone after signing in.
invite.daysLabel: The installer can set up panels for
invite.shownOnce: This code is shown only once. Copy it now.
invite.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.
invite.cancelled: Code cancelled. It can no longer be used.

revoke.title: Remove {{name}}?
revoke.body: {{name}} can no longer set up panels here. Panels they already set up stay, and any waiting for approval still wait for you.

approval.banner: Set up by {{name}} and waiting for your approval: {{count}}
approval.bannerMixed: Set up by installers and waiting for your approval: {{count}}
approval.bannerHelp: Check that each panel is in the right room, then approve or reject it.
approval.approveBody: Teachers can sign in on it once you approve. {{room}} gets a seat if one is free.
approval.rejectBody: The panel goes back to its setup screen and {{room}} becomes free. To use this panel again it needs a new setup code.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Panels that need a look, the most urgent first.

empty.title: Nothing needs attention
empty.body: Every panel is online, up to date and in use.

todo.OFFLINE: Check the panel is on and on Wi-Fi.
todo.NOT_CONFIRMED: Tap Confirm on the panel, or remove it and add it again.
todo.AWAITING_APPROVAL: Approve or reject it under Panels & rooms.
todo.UPDATE_REQUIRED: Open the panel and install the update.
todo.APP_OUTDATED: Open the panel and install the update.
todo.WEBVIEW_OLD: Update Android System WebView on the panel.
todo.UNUSED: Show teachers how to sign in.
todo.LICENCE_ROOM: Assign a seat to this room under Licences.
todo.LICENCE_ENDING: Renew before the end date to keep teachers signing in.
todo.other: Something on this panel needs a look. Reload this page for details.

alerts.summaryHelp: See the Alerts tab for what to do.

notify.title: Email alerts
notify.description: One email a day to the institute admins, listing only new problems. Nothing is sent on a day with nothing new.
notify.saveError: Could not save alert settings. Try again.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Classroom panels paired to this institute, and who is signed in on them.

empty.title: No panels yet
empty.body: A panel must first show a setup code. Open the Classroom app on the panel, then add it here with that code.

panels.liveClassHint: Live classes start from the teacher's device
panels.passwordToggle: Allow password sign-in on the panel in {{room}}

move.title: Move the panel in {{room}}
move.noFreeRooms: Every room has a panel. Add a room first.
move.help: No visit to the panel is needed. It shows the new room name within a minute.

revoke.title: Remove the panel in {{room}}?
revoke.body: Whoever is signed in on it is signed out, and it returns to its setup screen within a minute. {{room}} becomes free. To use this panel again you need a new setup code.

endSession.title: End the session in {{room}}?
endSession.body: {{teacher}} is signed out of the panel in {{room}} within a minute.

code.intro: Open the Classroom app on the panel. It shows a setup code and a number.
code.label: Setup code
code.invalid: Enter the 8-character code shown on the panel.
code.notFound: No panel is showing this code. Check it, or use the new code on the panel.

details.numberHelp: Tap the same number you can see on the panel.
details.numberRequired: Tap the number shown on the panel.
details.warning: Only pair a panel you can see right now. If someone sent you this code by message or phone, stop here.
details.wrongNumber: That number didn't match. The panel now shows a new code. Enter it to try again.
details.expired: This code has expired or was already used. Enter the new code shown on the panel.

replace.title: Replace the panel in {{room}}?
replace.body: {{room}} already has a panel: {{model}}, {{seen}}. Replacing removes that panel and signs out anyone using it. It needs a new setup code to be used again.

done.title: Now tap Confirm on the panel
done.activeBody: Teachers can now sign in on this panel.
done.declinedBody: {{room}} is free again. Use the new code on the panel to try again.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Each room holds one panel. The room name is what teachers see on the panel and on their phone.

empty.title: No rooms yet
empty.body: Add your rooms now, or name a new room when you add a panel. A panel must first show a setup code.

paste.title: Paste a list of rooms
paste.label: Room names
paste.help: One room per line, up to {{max}}. Names that already exist are skipped.
paste.required: Enter at least one room name.
paste.tooMany: Paste at most {{max}} rooms at a time.
paste.lineTooLong: Use at most {{max}} characters for each room: {{name}}

archive.title: Archive {{room}}?
archive.body: The room is removed from this list. Past sessions are kept, and you can add a room with the same name later.
